workarounds.symptom: AMD Radeon 780M Vulkan regression in Ollama >=0.32.10
workarounds.workaround: Fix: llm: use mmap for Vulkan integrated GPUs. Target files: llm/llama_server.go, llm/llama_server_test.go. Non-mmap loads put CPU-resident tensors in the Vulkan host buffer, which is drawn from the same device budget as the weights. On a shared-memory iGPU that roughly doubles the footprint and the load fails with "Failed to allocate pinned memory" or, on Windows AMD, 0xe06d7363. (Ref: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19640)

workarounds.symptom: Responses API silently truncates oversized input with truncation disabled (0.40.13 and 0.40.14, Bonsai 27B)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: openai: forward truncation option in responses requests. Target files: openai/responses.go, openai/responses_test.go, server/responses_compact.go. ﻿`FromResponsesRequest` previously omitted mapping the `Truncation` option to `api.ChatRequest.Truncate`. Because `Truncate` was nil on the resulting request, the chat handler defaulted `truncate` to `true`, causing oversized inputs to be silently shortened by the runner even when `truncation` was set to `"disabled"` (or left at the default `"disabled"`). (Ref: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19501)

workarounds.symptom: launch: `ollama launch opencode` fails on OpenCode v2 because `opencode debug config` returns an array
workarounds.workaround: Fix: cmd/launch: fix OpenCode v2 launch and config parsing. Target files: cmd/launch/opencode.go, cmd/launch/opencode_context_test.go. OpenCode v2 rejects `--model` on the bare command, and its shared service can keep the global default instead of the model selected by `ollama launch`. Use `--standalone` for detected v2 clients so the backend inherits the per-launch Ollama configuration. Keep detected v1 clients' explicit model selection and preserve forwarded arguments. workarounds.symptom: Intermittent /v1/responses stream closes during reasoning without a terminal event
workarounds.workaround: Fix: openai: preserve failures in Responses streams. Target files: middleware/openai.go, middleware/responses_errors_test.go, middleware/responses_web_search_test.go. When generation fails after `/v1/responses` starts streaming, HTTP 200 is already committed. The native `{"error":"..."}` envelope is decoded as an empty chat response, so clients receive EOF without a terminal failure event. Detect in-band generation errors and emit one `response.failed`.
